background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Ratings are A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, with one of the three on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 12 Jul 2021. Capital is the weak point: CET1 of 10.3% is in the bottom quarter of US banks and has fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025, with leverage also down 0.9 points to 5.8%, which still leaves it above the peer median. Liquidity is adequate, LCR of 119% above the median and broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Flagged items are operational, a trading outage in early September and continuing job cuts; the newest, on 18 Sep 2026, is a local news item of no credit relevance.
